newsitem.title: UK: Babcock plans 50 mln stg of disposals - paper.
newsitem.headline: Babcock plans 50 mln stg of disposals - paper.

text.p: British engineering group Babcock International is set to sell off a series of non-core businesses in a major streamlining plan which could generate up to 50 million sterling, a British newspaper said on Sunday.
The group is keen to dispose of its environmental and process engineering businesses, and is expected to shed its Africa division later this year, the Sunday Telegraph said.

The restructuring will leave the firm able to concentrate on its two core areas, facilities management and materials handling, which the paper said can generate a combined 500 million stg profitable turnover.
